name: B-Stance Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
cues: Set the back toes beside the front heel and keep most weight on the front foot
Hinge over the front leg with the dumbbells close to your shin
Keep your hips square and your front knee softly bent
Drive through the front heel to stand
